Use case: stylized-concept. Single isolated base sprite for a Chinese ink-wash cultivation game's animated UI, genuine transparent background, square composition. A restrained hand-painted MONOCHROME CHINESE INK STUDY, spare dry-brush marks and diluted ink washes, matte, asymmetric organic brush edges, substantial empty space, visible irregular bristle textures. ONLY desaturated charcoal and a very small amount of muted grey-celadon. Graphic, abstract and austere, readable at 240 pixels, not photorealistic. Main form centered within the middle 65% of the canvas, no cut-off edges. DO NOT add surrounding qi ribbons or smoke because real flowing particles will be animated separately by code. No text, symbols, letters, frame, backdrop or labels. ABSOLUTELY NO real human, facial features, skin, hair strands, clothing details, realistic figure, pretty person, anime character, jewelry, jade ornaments, gold filigree, glossy 3D, cinematic lighting, magical sparkles, elaborately decorated objects, mobile-game character splash art. Simple does not mean clean vector: preserve hand-painted ink texture.
炼气 / qi sea BASE: an open circular wash of diluted ink suggesting a spacious dantian inner sea, three incomplete sweeping charcoal brush arcs circling a mostly EMPTY center. Slightly irregular Chinese calligraphic brush curvature, denser lower-left, very pale upper-right. A small soft grey-celadon ink seed below the exact center. NO yin-yang symbol, no human silhouette, no face, no clouds. The center and the gaps must stay empty transparent for an animated current to circulate through them. Spare, quiet, one bold brush gesture.

NO architectural platform, steps, crystals, carved jade bowl, lotus petals, decorative rim, droplets in mid-air, rays, cloud ribbons.
